summary: Tested Vanguard Citadel Sec landing site: 9/9 backend pytest cases passed (health, contact happy path, 422 validation for invalid email / missing name / missing message / empty name / short message, optional company). Frontend smoke + integration via Playwright: all 5 sections + footer render, all 4 nav links + CTA smooth-scroll, 10 service cards, 6 compliance cards, 2 leader cards present with correct names, contact form submits successfully and shows contact-form-success state, mobile menu toggle opens menu and links navigate then auto-close on selection.

issues: 'Made with Emergent' badge overlaps bottom-right area; harmless but can intercept clicks during automation

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined AFTER it is first referenced inside submit_contact at runtime; works because logging.basicConfig+getLogger run at module import before any request, but stylistically logger setup should be moved above route definitions for clarity.
Contact endpoint intentionally MOCKED - no DB persistence, no email send. Per product decision (wire email later).

CORS allow_origins reads CORS_ORIGINS env (default '*') with allow_credentials=True - allowing credentials with wildcard origin is technically invalid per spec; consider restricting to known origins before production.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has only 2 endpoints under /api: GET /api/health and POST /api/contact (Pydantic-validated). Contact endpoint is MOCKED - only logs and returns success. Frontend is a single-page site with sections identified by hero-section/about-section/services-section/compliance-section/contact-section data-testids and a Navbar with nav-link-* and nav-mobile-* testids. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env for API calls.
